wholePhysicalScope: Lassis Inn’s compact blue-sided restaurant at 518 East 27th Street in Little Rock, as photographed July 5, 2024. The scope includes the false-front parapet, awning, signage, concrete stair and attached side ramp.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the stepped blue storefront, stair, awning and east ramp. Near levels add the original sign lettering, glazing recesses and service fixtures.
limitations: Four July 2024 CC0 photographs establish the stepped false front, blue siding, pale window frames, concrete steps, signs and attached side landing.
Individual roof pitches, fittings, side ramp dimensions and rear openings are approximations. The attached name uses original geometric letters. Other poster graphics are simplified.
The detached sign, surrounding lot, landscaping and street are outside the building asset. The original local elevation field is unchanged.
